# Business profile
La Sorella. Café in Fishkill, NY serving breakfast, sandwiches, salads, soups, pastries, coffee, cocktails and wine.
Address: 992 Main Street, Suite 22, Fishkill, NY 12524
Phone: 845-871-2010
Email: lasorellafishkill@gmail.com
Website: https://www.lasorellafishkill.com

# Opening hours
Sunday: 08:00–14:00
Monday: closed
Tuesday: 08:00–16:00
Wednesday: 08:00–16:00
Thursday: 08:00–16:00
Friday: 08:00–16:00
Saturday: 08:00–16:00

# Special dates
2026-12-25: closed (Closed for Christmas (invented for the test))

# Other information
## Online ordering
Order online through the 'Online ordering' link on lasorellafishkill.com.
## Gift cards
Gift cards are sold through the 'Gift Cards' page on lasorellafishkill.com.
## Sister restaurant
Our sister restaurant is Il Figlio Enoteca.

# FAQs
none
